name: Proxmox Mail Gateway Detection Suite
name_zh: Proxmox Mail Gateway 偵測套組
summary: Logins (including second-factor failures, spraying and brute force), viruses and ClamAV heuristics, phishing and DMARC-failing mail that was delivered, new BCC copy targets, outgoing virus, spam and volume, quarantine releases, filter, cluster, update and backup failures, exploit attempts and REST API changes on Proxmox Mail Gateway, which Wazuh does not decode at all.
summary_zh: Proxmox Mail Gateway 的登入（含第二因素失敗、密碼噴灑與暴力破解）、病毒與 ClamAV 啟發式命中、已投遞的釣魚信與 DMARC 驗證失敗郵件、新的密件副本目標、外寄病毒／垃圾信／大量外寄、隔離區放行、過濾／叢集／更新／備份故障、漏洞利用嘗試，以及 REST API 變更；Wazuh 內建完全不解碼 PMG。
notes: Wazuh ships no decoder for Proxmox Mail Gateway: its Proxmox decoders take pvedaemon, pveproxy and pvestatd by name, not pmgdaemon, pmgproxy or pmg-smtp-filter. On a PMG 9 gateway a failed web login reached only the generic rule 2501, and nothing PMG writes about mail, quarantines, the cluster or its own services matched a rule. Replaying 6,748 real lines from one gateway (PMG, ClamAV, postscreen and Postfix, nine to thirty days), with no list filled in, version 1.2 raised one pack alert a day (a failing daily package update, level 7), one first-login alert for the gateway's API account and one first-copy alert for its only BCC target; the other 491 logins of that account stayed at level 2. Two built-in alert sources on a gateway drop to level 2: the hourly ClamAV update check (52507, level 3, 24 a day) and refused internet senders without a DNS name (3303, level 5, 449 in 30 days). The rules were written against pmg-api 9.1.4 source; they also read the RFC 3339 timestamps PMG 8 and later write by default.

Logins, quiet by default with no list filled in. PMG writes a successful login, and every renewal of an open session (every 15 minutes), as the same line, with the account but without the client address; with two-factor authentication the password step writes it too. An ordinary login is recorded at level 2. The first login of each account on a gateway is level 3, once ever (first-time-seen), so an API account that logs in every 2 minutes (measured: 720 logins a day) alerts once. root@pam, PMG's built-in superuser and the only account of the pam realm, is level 3 at most once an hour per gateway; the renewals of its session in that hour are level 2. A login after three failures for the same account within 10 minutes is level 10, after a brute-force alert for it level 12. A failure is level 5 with the client address and PMG's reason; six from one address within five minutes are level 10, six for different accounts from one address within 10 minutes are password spraying, level 10. A failed second factor is level 10: PMG checks it only after a correct password, so someone has that password; a second factor locked after repeated wrong codes is level 12 (these lines exist since pmg-api 8.0.2, the fix for CVE-2023-43320). A login attempt to a disabled or expired account is level 6. End users opening their spam quarantine are level 2. etc/lists/jt-pmg-service-accounts is optional tuning: listed accounts drop to level 0 on success and still alert after failures. The PAM copy of a failed login in auth.log (built-in 2501, level 5) drops to level 2 because pmgdaemon reports the same failure with the realm and the address.

Logins from a public address: since the syslog line has no address, the pmgproxy access log is used. A login request answered from an address outside 10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 127/8, 100.64/10, ::1, fc00::/7 and fe80::/10 is level 5, further requests from that address within the hour level 2. The web interface logs in through /api2/extjs/, which answers 200 even for a wrong password, so this means a login or a renewal was attempted from the internet; the account is in the syslog line of the same second. Which account it was cannot be told from this line, so the pack cannot raise a superuser login from the internet above level 5. PMG writes client addresses IPv4-mapped (::ffff:a.b.c.d), which Wazuh's address matching does not see as IPv4: the pack recognises private addresses by the start of the line, and strips the prefix in its own decoder for the failure lines.

Viruses and heuristics: a virus found in a mail is level 7 (one line per mail). PMG does not treat a ClamAV heuristic as a virus: it logs it and only adds 3 to the spam score, so the mail is usually delivered. The pack therefore rates the heuristic itself: a malformed executable, overlapping zip entries, an obfuscated PDF or a W32/Trojan heuristic is level 7, a phishing heuristic level 5, an encrypted attachment ClamAV could not scan level 5, any other heuristic level 3. An attachment removed or moved to the attachment quarantine by a rule such as PMG's default 'Block Dangerous Files' is level 3 with the file name; twenty within 10 minutes are level 7 (a campaign). A mail with a broken or ambiguous MIME structure is level 3 (refused by default since pmg-api 9.1.2, the sender retries), ten within 10 minutes level 7; if the gateway accepts it because accept-broken-mime is on, level 5, since content-type rules may not have applied to it (PSA-2026-00005-1). The clamd copy of a mail virus (built-in 52502, level 8) drops to level 2; scans outside the PMG spool still alert.

Outgoing mail. PMG decides whether a mail is outgoing but logs only the name of the rule that acted, so outgoing virus and spam are recognised by rule name: etc/lists/jt-pmg-outbound-rules lists the rules that act on outgoing mail only, with PMG's default names 'Virus Alert' and 'Block outgoing Spam'. A block or quarantine by one of them is level 12 for a virus (an infected internal sender) and level 10 for spam (a compromised account or host), at most one alert a minute; a gateway whose outgoing rules are renamed or translated needs their names added. Independent of rule names, the pack counts outgoing transactions: pmg-smtp-filter logs every connection on its outgoing port 10023, and 250 within 10 minutes on one gateway is level 10 (a hijacked account or an infected host sending spam). That is far above a small or mid-size site's normal volume; a site that normally relays more than about 25 mails a minute raises the threshold (see the setup step). Failed DKIM signing (outgoing mail leaves unsigned and fails DMARC) is level 6, at most hourly.

SpamAssassin verdicts tied to delivery and copies of mail. PMG logs the SpamAssassin tests that hit each mail and, separately, each delivery, both with the mail's log ID. A mail with a URL that Spamhaus DBL or SURBL list for phishing or malware is recorded at level 2 and becomes level 7 only if the same mail is then delivered; a mail from a domain whose DMARC policy asks for rejection or quarantine that failed the check becomes level 6 when delivered. Quarantined or blocked mail does not alert. SpamAssassin's DNS list queries being refused (Spamhaus or URIBL 'blocked' answers to a public resolver) is level 7, at most hourly: scoring then runs without those lists. The first time a gateway copies mail to an address through a BCC action is level 8, once per address (first-time-seen): a BCC rule is how someone with administrator access would copy every mail to an outside mailbox. A BCC target written as a macro alerts once per new address it produces. A failed BCC copy is level 5.

Quarantine releases: from the spam quarantine level 3 (end users release their own spam), from the attachment quarantine level 5, from the virus quarantine level 10. The syslog line does not say who released it; the pmgproxy access log line for POST .../quarantine/content just before it names the account. PMG 8.0 to 8.1.6 write the line without the recipient (added in pmg-api 8.1.7); version 1.1 of this pack missed those, 1.2 reads both.

Failures that stop or weaken filtering are level 10: virus scanning failed, an accepted mail that cannot be handed back to Postfix, Postfix unable to reach the filter on 127.0.0.1:10023/10024, a burst of filter process errors, and pmg-smtp-filter, Postfix, clamd, pmgpolicy or PostgreSQL failing under systemd; other PMG services failing are level 7. When clamd is down, clamdscan still prints a summary and PMG may log nothing about the scan, so the service rule is the one that catches it.

Housekeeping: cluster synchronisation errors and an aborted LDAP profile sync are level 7 (the sync runs every 2 minutes and is silent while it reports 0 errors; a broken peer alerts at most every 30 minutes). A failed ClamAV signature update, a download refused by the mirror or a cool-down after one is level 7, at most hourly; the built-in rule 52509 keeps those at level 0. An outdated ClamAV engine (freshclam names the local and the recommended version) is level 5, once a day: the engine parses every attachment. A failed task is level 5; a failed package update check, ClamAV or SpamAssassin update or configuration backup task is level 7 (no security updates or no backups); a failed ACME certificate renewal level 7. A root shell opened from the web interface or a service stopped from it is level 5.

Postfix: an answer in 127.255.255.0/24 from a DNS blocklist (Spamhaus refusing a query sent through a public resolver, or too many queries) is level 10, because a postscreen setup without an answer filter then scores every client as listed; repeated postscreen lookup timeouts are level 7. A Postfix daemon killed by a signal, exiting with an error or throttled is level 7 (built-in rules leave these at level 0). A client sending bare newlines, the technique behind SMTP smuggling, is level 5, but only if Postfix logs it: PMG's default smtpd_forbid_bare_newline = normalize logs nothing (see the setup step). A refused internet sender whose address has no matching DNS name drops from built-in 3303 (level 5) to level 2; other 450 replies, and the same reply to a private address, stay at 3303. These rules and the TLS certificate rule apply to any Postfix server, not only PMG. Independently, keep Postfix updated: with before-queue filtering (PMG's default), Postfix 3.10.14 and 3.11.7 closed a smuggling path through smtpd_proxy_filter.

REST API changes from the pmgproxy access log: users, realms and two-factor settings level 8 (a second factor removed, disabled or unlocked 10), mail filter rules 8 (rule database reset to factory defaults 10), trusted networks and transports 8, SMTP welcomelist 7, other gateway settings 6, cluster membership 8, configuration restore 8, deleting queued mail 6, certificates 6, node reboot 6. A configuration backup downloaded is level 8 (backups made before pmg-api 9.1.3 hold the key that signs login tickets). An APT changelog request whose package name starts with a dash is level 10: the PSA-2026-00001-1 option injection (fixed in pmg-api 9.0.3), whatever the answer. The agent group keeps only POST, PUT and DELETE requests, backup downloads and changelog requests. The web interface calls /api2/extjs/, which logs status 200 even for a refused change, so these alerts mean the change was requested; the acting user is in the full log line.

Deliberately not alerted: rejections by postscreen, DNS blocklists, SPF or greylisting, and quarantined or marked inbound spam. They are the gateway doing its job; the built-in Postfix rules (3303, 3306 and their burst rules 3353, 3356) still apply to them, except the refused senders without a DNS name described above. Not built: rules for Postfix connection and rate limits and for a ClamAV hit on files outside a mail spool (a webshell or rootkit on the gateway itself), since they concern every Postfix or ClamAV host and belong in a pack for those. No active response is offered against mail senders: postscreen and the blocklists reject them before SMTP, spam sources change addresses, and a wrong firewall block stops all mail from that sender.

Cross-pack login groups (patch release): jt_auth_success on 132401, 132491, 132493, 132403, 132492; jt_auth_failure on 132404, 132408, 132497; jt_auth_lockout on 132495. They let jt-account-guard correlate logins across services and jt-ioc look up the address of every tagged successful login; levels and matching are unchanged, and without those packs the groups do nothing. The success line of pmgdaemon carries no address; the web access copy (132473) is not tagged. A wrong second factor (132409) is not a failed password and is not tagged. 132405, 132496 and 132490 now count failures through the pack-only group jt_pmg_login_failure (on 132404 only) instead of if_matched_sid 132404: same rules, same thresholds, but the failures also reach the cross-pack group lists, which skip any rule named by an if_matched_sid.

Deployment details. The agent group collects only /var/log/pmgproxy/pmgproxy.log; everything else comes from the syslog files the agent already reads. An agent that reads /var/log/syslog together with mail.log, mail.info or messages receives every mail line two or three times (measured on one gateway: three copies of each Postfix and ClamAV line), and that also multiplies the counts the volume rules use. Limiting pmgproxy (port 8006, web interface and API) with ALLOW_FROM, DENY_FROM and POLICY in /etc/default/pmgproxy (admin guide, section 10.2.2) is a better first defence against the login attacks this pack reports than any block after the fact, and keeps API bugs such as the PSA advisories out of reach from the internet.
notes_zh: Wazuh 沒有 Proxmox Mail Gateway 的解碼器：內建的 Proxmox 解碼器只認 pvedaemon、pveproxy、pvestatd，不認 pmgdaemon、pmgproxy 或 pmg-smtp-filter。在 PMG 9 閘道上，網頁登入失敗只命中通用規則 2501，PMG 關於郵件、隔離區、叢集與自身服務的記錄完全不命中任何規則。以一台閘道 6,748 行真實記錄（PMG、ClamAV、postscreen、Postfix，九到三十天）重放，不填任何清單，1.2 版每天只產生一則告警（每日套件更新失敗，level 7），另有該閘道 API 帳號的一則首次登入告警，以及唯一一個密件副本目標的一則首次複製告警；這個帳號其餘 491 次登入都停在 level 2。閘道上兩個內建告警來源降為 level 2：每小時一次的 ClamAV 更新檢查（52507，level 3，每天 24 則），以及被拒收、沒有 DNS 名稱的網際網路寄件主機（3303，level 5，30 天 449 則）。規則依 pmg-api 9.1.4 原始碼撰寫，也能讀 PMG 8 起預設的 RFC 3339 時間格式。

登入預設就安靜，不必填任何清單。PMG 把成功登入與開著的工作階段每 15 分鐘一次的續期記成同一行，只有帳號、沒有用戶端位址；啟用雙因素驗證時，密碼那一步也會寫這一行。一般登入記錄為 level 2。每個帳號在一台閘道上的第一次登入為 level 3，永遠只有一次（first-time-seen），所以每 2 分鐘登入一次的 API 帳號（實測每天 720 次）只告警一次。root@pam 是 PMG 內建的超級使用者，也是 pam realm 唯一的帳號，每台閘道每小時最多一則 level 3，這一小時內的工作階段續期為 level 2。同一帳號 10 分鐘內失敗三次後登入成功為 level 10，在針對它的暴力破解告警之後登入成功為 level 12。登入失敗為 level 5，帶用戶端位址與 PMG 記錄的原因；同一位址五分鐘內失敗六次為 level 10，同一位址 10 分鐘內對六個不同帳號失敗為密碼噴灑，level 10。第二因素驗證失敗為 level 10：PMG 只在密碼正確之後才檢查第二因素，代表有人知道那組密碼；連續輸錯導致第二因素被鎖定為 level 12（這些記錄自 pmg-api 8.0.2 起才有，也就是 CVE-2023-43320 的修正）。嘗試登入已停用或已過期的帳號為 level 6。一般使用者開啟垃圾信隔離區為 level 2。etc/lists/jt-pmg-service-accounts 只是選用的調校：列入的帳號成功登入降為 level 0，失敗之後的登入仍會告警。auth.log 裡 PAM 那份登入失敗（內建 2501，level 5）降為 level 2，因為 pmgdaemon 已帶著 realm 與位址回報同一次失敗。

來自公共位址的登入：syslog 那行沒有位址，所以改用 pmgproxy 存取記錄。登入請求的來源不在 10/8、172.16/12、192.168/16、127/8、100.64/10、::1、fc00::/7、fe80::/10 時為 level 5，同一位址一小時內的後續請求為 level 2。網頁介面透過 /api2/extjs/ 登入，密碼錯誤也回 200，所以這代表「有人從網際網路嘗試登入或續期」；帳號在同一秒的 syslog 那行。從這行看不出是哪個帳號，所以本套件無法把超級使用者從網際網路登入提高到 level 5 以上。PMG 把用戶端位址寫成 IPv4 對映格式（::ffff:a.b.c.d），Wazuh 的位址比對不會當成 IPv4：本套件以記錄行的開頭辨識私有位址，登入失敗那行則在自己的解碼器裡去掉前綴。

病毒與啟發式命中：郵件中發現病毒為 level 7（每封信一行）。PMG 不把 ClamAV 的啟發式命中當成病毒：只記錄並在垃圾信分數加 3，郵件通常照常投遞。所以本套件依啟發式本身分級：格式異常的執行檔、重疊的 zip 項目、混淆過的 PDF、W32／Trojan 類啟發式為 level 7，釣魚啟發式為 level 5，ClamAV 無法掃描的加密附件為 level 5，其他啟發式為 level 3。附件被規則（例如 PMG 預設的「Block Dangerous Files」）移除或移到附件隔離區為 level 3，帶檔名；10 分鐘內二十則為 level 7（攻擊活動）。MIME 結構損壞或有歧義的郵件為 level 3（pmg-api 9.1.2 起預設拒收，寄件端會重試），10 分鐘內十則為 level 7；若因為啟用了 accept-broken-mime 而被收下，則為 level 5，因為內容類型規則可能沒有套用到它（PSA-2026-00005-1）。clamd 那份郵件病毒記錄（內建 52502，level 8）降為 level 2；PMG 佇列以外的掃描仍會告警。

外寄郵件。PMG 自己判斷郵件是不是外寄，但記錄只寫出動作的規則名稱，所以外寄病毒與垃圾信以規則名稱辨識：etc/lists/jt-pmg-outbound-rules 列出只處理外寄郵件的規則，內含 PMG 預設的「Virus Alert」與「Block outgoing Spam」。被其中一條阻擋或隔離時，病毒為 level 12（內部寄件者中毒），垃圾信為 level 10（帳號或主機可能遭入侵），每分鐘最多一則；外寄規則改過名稱或翻譯過的閘道要把名稱加進清單。與規則名稱無關的是外寄量：pmg-smtp-filter 會記錄外寄連接埠 10023 的每一次連線，一台閘道 10 分鐘內 250 次為 level 10（被盜用的帳號或中毒的主機在寄垃圾信）。這遠高於中小型站台平常的量；平常每分鐘轉送超過約 25 封的站台請調高門檻（見部署步驟）。DKIM 簽章失敗（外寄郵件未簽章送出、在收件端 DMARC 失敗）為 level 6，每小時最多一則。

與投遞結果相連的 SpamAssassin 判定，以及郵件副本。PMG 會記錄每封信命中的 SpamAssassin 測試，另外記錄每一次投遞，兩者都帶郵件的記錄 ID。內含 Spamhaus DBL 或 SURBL 列為釣魚或惡意程式網址的郵件先記錄為 level 2，只有同一封信接著被投遞時才成為 level 7；寄件網域的 DMARC 政策要求拒收或隔離、而驗證失敗的郵件，被投遞時為 level 6。被隔離或阻擋的郵件不告警。SpamAssassin 的 DNS 黑名單查詢被拒（Spamhaus 或 URIBL 對公共 DNS 回應「blocked」）為 level 7，每小時最多一則：此時評分沒有用到這些清單。閘道第一次透過密件副本（BCC）動作把郵件複製到某個位址為 level 8，每個位址一次（first-time-seen）：有管理權限的人要把所有郵件複製到外部信箱，用的就是 BCC 規則。BCC 目標寫成巨集時，每產生一個新位址告警一次。BCC 複製失敗為 level 5。

隔離區放行：從垃圾信隔離區放行為 level 3（使用者會自行放行），從附件隔離區為 level 5，從病毒隔離區為 level 10。syslog 那行沒寫是誰放行的；緊接在前、pmgproxy 存取記錄裡的 POST .../quarantine/content 那行有帳號。PMG 8.0 到 8.1.6 這行沒有收件者（pmg-api 8.1.7 才加上）；本套件 1.1 版讀不到這種寫法，1.2 版兩種都讀。

會讓過濾停擺或打折的故障為 level 10：病毒掃描失敗、已接收的郵件無法交回 Postfix、Postfix 連不上 127.0.0.1:10023/10024 的過濾程式、過濾程序短時間內大量出錯，以及 pmg-smtp-filter、Postfix、clamd、pmgpolicy、PostgreSQL 在 systemd 下失敗；其他 PMG 服務失敗為 level 7。clamd 停止時 clamdscan 仍會印出摘要，PMG 可能完全不記錄掃描失敗，所以抓到它的是服務規則。

例行維護：叢集同步錯誤與 LDAP 設定檔同步中止為 level 7（同步每 2 分鐘一次，回報 0 errors 時不出聲；壞掉的節點最多每 30 分鐘告警一次）。ClamAV 病毒碼更新失敗、被鏡像站拒絕或因此進入冷卻期為 level 7，每小時最多一次；內建規則 52509 把這些留在 level 0。ClamAV 引擎過舊（freshclam 會列出本機與建議的版本）為 level 5，每天一次：每個附件都由這個引擎解析。任務失敗為 level 5；套件更新檢查、ClamAV 或 SpamAssassin 更新、設定備份任務失敗為 level 7（收不到安全更新或沒有備份）；ACME 憑證自動更新失敗為 level 7。從網頁介面開啟 root shell 或停止服務為 level 5。

Postfix：DNS 黑名單回應落在 127.255.255.0/24（Spamhaus 拒絕經由公共 DNS 送來的查詢或查詢過多）為 level 10，因為沒有設定回應過濾的 postscreen 會因此把每個用戶端都當成已列入；postscreen 查詢一再逾時為 level 7。Postfix 服務程序被訊號終止、以錯誤結束或被節流為 level 7（內建規則把這些留在 level 0）。用戶端送出單獨的換行字元（SMTP smuggling 所用的手法）為 level 5，但前提是 Postfix 有記錄：PMG 預設的 smtpd_forbid_bare_newline = normalize 什麼都不記（見部署步驟）。被拒收、位址沒有對應 DNS 名稱的網際網路寄件主機，從內建 3303（level 5）降為 level 2；其他 450 回應，以及對私有位址的同一種回應，仍為 3303。這些規則與 TLS 憑證規則適用於任何 Postfix 伺服器，不只 PMG。另外請保持 Postfix 更新：使用佇列前過濾（PMG 預設）時，Postfix 3.10.14 與 3.11.7 修正了一條經由 smtpd_proxy_filter 的 smuggling 途徑。

REST API 變更取自 pmgproxy 存取記錄：使用者、realm 與雙因素設定為 level 8（移除、停用或解鎖第二因素為 10），郵件過濾規則為 8（規則資料庫重設回出廠值為 10），信任網段與 transport 為 8，SMTP 白名單為 7，其他閘道設定為 6，叢集成員變更為 8，設定還原為 8，刪除佇列中的郵件為 6，憑證為 6，節點重新開機為 6。下載設定備份為 level 8（pmg-api 9.1.3 之前的備份含有簽發登入票證的金鑰）。套件名稱以減號開頭的 APT changelog 請求為 level 10：這是 PSA-2026-00001-1 的選項注入（pmg-api 9.0.3 修正），不論回應為何都告警。agent 群組只保留 POST、PUT、DELETE 請求、備份下載與 changelog 請求。網頁介面呼叫的是 /api2/extjs/，即使變更被拒絕也記錄狀態 200，所以這些告警代表「有人要求變更」；執行者在完整記錄行中。

刻意不告警：postscreen、DNS 黑名單、SPF、灰名單的拒收，以及被隔離或標記的外來垃圾信。那是閘道在正常工作；內建的 Postfix 規則（3303、3306 及其大量發生規則 3353、3356）照樣適用，只有上面提到的「沒有 DNS 名稱的寄件主機」例外。沒有做：Postfix 連線數與速率限制的規則，以及 ClamAV 在郵件佇列以外的檔案找到 webshell 或 rootkit（閘道本身遭入侵）的規則，因為它們涉及所有 Postfix 或 ClamAV 主機，應放在那類主機的套件。不提供針對寄件者的主動回應：postscreen 與黑名單在 SMTP 之前就拒收了，垃圾信來源會換位址，而誤封的防火牆規則會擋掉該寄件者所有的郵件。

跨套件登入群組（修補版）：jt_auth_success：132401, 132491, 132493, 132403, 132492；jt_auth_failure：132404, 132408, 132497；jt_auth_lockout：132495。讓 jt-account-guard 跨服務關聯登入、jt-ioc 查詢每一筆加標記的成功登入來源位址；等級與比對條件不變，沒有安裝這些套件時群組沒有作用。pmgdaemon 的成功登入那行沒有位址；網頁存取那份（132473）不加標記。第二因素錯誤（132409）不是密碼錯誤，不加標記。132405、132496 與 132490 改以只在 132404 上的套件專屬群組 jt_pmg_login_failure 計算失敗，不再用 if_matched_sid 132404：同樣的規則與門檻，但失敗事件也能進入跨套件群組清單（被 if_matched_sid 指名的規則會被群組清單略過）。

部署細節。agent 群組只收集 /var/log/pmgproxy/pmgproxy.log；其餘內容來自 agent 本來就在讀的 syslog 檔。同時讀 /var/log/syslog 與 mail.log、mail.info 或 messages 的 agent，每行郵件記錄會收到兩三次（一台閘道實測：每行 Postfix 與 ClamAV 記錄三份），計量類規則用的次數也會跟著加倍。以 /etc/default/pmgproxy 的 ALLOW_FROM、DENY_FROM 與 POLICY 限制 pmgproxy（8006 埠，網頁介面與 API；管理手冊 10.2.2 節），是對付本套件回報的登入攻擊更好的第一道防線，勝過事後封鎖，也讓 PSA 公告這類 API 漏洞無法從網際網路觸及。
author: Jason Tools

agent_group.name: pmg
agent_group.description: The Proxmox Mail Gateway log outside syslog: REST API changes, backup downloads and changelog requests from the pmgproxy access log

setup.title: Install the pack and reload every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並重新載入所有節點
setup.body:
1. Install the pack from this page.
2. On the Rules tab, click Reload Ruleset. A cluster copies rule files to the workers but does not reload them.
setup.body_zh:
1. 在本頁安裝套件。
2. 到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集會把規則檔複製到 worker，但不會重新載入。
setup.verify: On the Rules tab, a hierarchy search for jt_pmg lists the rules of zz-132400-jt_pmg_rules.xml.
setup.verify_zh: 在「規則」分頁的階層模式搜尋 jt_pmg，會列出 zz-132400-jt_pmg_rules.xml 的規則。

setup.title: Assign the PMG nodes to the pmg group
setup.title_zh: 把 PMG 節點加入 pmg 群組
setup.body:
1. On the manager, run the two commands with the node's agent ID in place of <agent_id>. Repeat for every PMG node.
2. Logins, mail filter, Postfix and ClamAV come from syslog, which the agent already reads. Read each copy once: do not read /var/log/syslog together with mail.log, mail.info or messages, or every mail alert arrives two or three times.
3. A node that logs only to journald: add a journald localfile to the agent's own ossec.conf.
setup.body_zh:
1. 在 manager 上執行這兩行指令，把 <agent_id> 換成該節點的 agent ID。每個 PMG 節點都要做。
2. 登入、郵件過濾、Postfix 與 ClamAV 來自 syslog，agent 本來就會讀。每份內容只讀一次：不要同時讀 /var/log/syslog 與 mail.log、mail.info 或 messages，否則每則郵件告警會出現兩三次。
3. 只寫 journald 的節點：在該 agent 自己的 ossec.conf 加上 journald 的 localfile。
setup.verify: Change and save any setting under Configuration > Mail Proxy. Expect rule 132466 (level 6) on the manager.
setup.verify_zh: 在「Configuration > Mail Proxy」改一個設定並儲存，manager 端應出現規則 132466（level 6）。

setup.title: Optional: silence automation accounts' first login
setup.title_zh: 選用：讓自動化帳號第一次登入也不告警
setup.body: Not needed: an account that logs in every few minutes is level 2 after its first login. Only to silence that one alert: add one line per account, the full user ID with its realm as PMG writes it, then reload the ruleset. A login after failures still alerts.
setup.body_zh: 通常不需要：每幾分鐘登入一次的帳號，第一次之後本來就是 level 2。只有要連那一則告警也不要時才做：每個帳號一行，寫 PMG 記錄裡含 realm 的完整使用者 ID，加入後重新載入規則集。失敗之後的登入仍會告警。

setup.title: Name your outgoing-only PMG rules
setup.title_zh: 列出你自己的外寄專用 PMG 規則
setup.body: Only if you renamed or translated 'Virus Alert' or 'Block outgoing Spam', or have rules of your own for outgoing mail only. Add each name exactly as Mail Filter > Rules shows it, followed by :virus or :spam, then reload the ruleset. Write a name that contains a colon in double quotes.
setup.body_zh: 只有在你改過或翻譯過「Virus Alert」或「Block outgoing Spam」，或有自己的外寄專用規則時才需要。照「Mail Filter > Rules」顯示的名稱逐一加入，後接 :virus 或 :spam，再重新載入規則集。名稱含冒號時要用雙引號括起來。

setup.title: Activate the outgoing spam rule in PMG
setup.title_zh: 在 PMG 啟用外寄垃圾信規則
setup.body: In Mail Filter > Rules, activate 'Block outgoing Spam' (inactive by default). Without it PMG relays outgoing spam and rule 132424 never fires. It blocks outgoing mail that scores as spam (level 3 and up by default) and notifies the administrator, so check the threshold against your own outgoing mail first.
setup.body_zh: 在「Mail Filter > Rules」啟用「Block outgoing Spam」（預設停用）。沒有它，PMG 會照常轉送外寄垃圾信，規則 132424 永遠不會觸發。啟用後，分數達垃圾信標準（預設 level 3 以上）的外寄郵件會被阻擋並通知管理者，請先用自己的外寄郵件確認門檻。

setup.title: Recommended: limit the web interface to management networks
setup.title_zh: 建議：網頁介面只開放給管理網段
setup.body:
1. Append the lines to /etc/default/pmgproxy, with your management networks in ALLOW_FROM. End users who open the spam quarantine on the web must be in an allowed network too.
2. Restart pmgproxy. Open web sessions end; mail is not affected.
3. Test from an allowed address before you close the current session.
setup.body_zh:
1. 把這幾行加到 /etc/default/pmgproxy，在 ALLOW_FROM 填入你的管理網段。透過網頁開啟垃圾信隔離區的一般使用者也必須在允許的網段內。
2. 重新啟動 pmgproxy。開著的網頁工作階段會中斷，郵件不受影響。
3. 關閉目前的工作階段之前，先從允許的位址測試一次。
setup.code:
cat >> /etc/default/pmgproxy <<'EOF'
ALLOW_FROM="192.0.2.0/24,127.0.0.1"
DENY_FROM="all"
POLICY="allow"
EOF
systemctl restart pmgproxy
setup.verify: From an address outside ALLOW_FROM, https://<gateway>:8006 must be refused; from an allowed one it still opens.
setup.verify_zh: 從 ALLOW_FROM 以外的位址連 https://<閘道>:8006 應被拒絕；從允許的位址仍可開啟。

setup.title: Optional: make Postfix log bare newlines
setup.title_zh: 選用：讓 Postfix 記錄單獨換行
setup.body: Rule 132487 (SMTP smuggling) needs smtpd_forbid_bare_newline = note; PMG's default normalize protects the same way but logs nothing. PMG builds main.cf from templates, so the commands make a template override. Compare it with the shipped template after every PMG upgrade. Postfix reloads; mail keeps flowing.
setup.body_zh: 規則 132487（SMTP smuggling）需要 smtpd_forbid_bare_newline = note；PMG 預設的 normalize 防護效果相同但什麼都不記錄。PMG 由範本產生 main.cf，所以這些指令會建立一份範本覆寫。每次 PMG 升級後，要和新的範本比對。Postfix 會重新載入，郵件不中斷。
setup.code:
mkdir -p /etc/pmg/templates
cp /var/lib/pmg/templates/main.cf.in /etc/pmg/templates/main.cf.in
sed -i 's/^smtpd_forbid_bare_newline = normalize/smtpd_forbid_bare_newline = note/' /etc/pmg/templates/main.cf.in
pmgconfig sync --restart 1
postconf smtpd_forbid_bare_newline

setup.title: Optional: raise the outgoing volume threshold
setup.body:
Rule 132484 alerts at 250 outgoing mails in 10 minutes on one gateway. Only if normal peaks are higher (PMG's hourly outgoing statistics):
1. Create the file below with your threshold in place of 600 (frequency). Keep level, ignore and if_matched_sid. The zzz- name makes it load after the pack.
2. Run wazuh-analysisd -t, then reload the ruleset.
Pack updates leave your file alone.
setup.body_zh:
規則 132484 在一台閘道 10 分鐘內外寄 250 封時告警。只有平常尖峰就更高時（看 PMG 統計中每小時的外寄數）才需要：
1. 建立下面的檔案，把 600（frequency）換成你的門檻。level、ignore 與 if_matched_sid 保持不變。檔名以 zzz- 開頭，才會在本套件之後載入。
2. 執行 wazuh-analysisd -t，再重新載入規則集。
套件更新不會動到你的檔案。
setup.code:
cat > /var/ossec/etc/rules/zzz-132484-site.xml <<'EOF'
<group name="pmg,jt_pmg,">
  <rule id="132484" level="10" frequency="600" timeframe="600" ignore="3600" overwrite="yes">
    <if_matched_sid>132483</if_matched_sid>
    <description>[WARN] PMG: unusually many outgoing mails within 10 minutes: a hijacked account or an infected internal host may be sending spam</description>
    <mitre>
      <id>T1586.002</id>
      <id>T1078</id>
    </mitre>
    <group>spam,</group>
  </rule>
</group>
EOF
/var/ossec/bin/wazuh-analysisd -t
setup.verify: analysisd -t reports no error; after Reload Ruleset the rule detail of 132484 shows the new frequency.
setup.verify_zh: analysisd -t 沒有錯誤；重新載入規則集後，132484 的規則內容顯示新的 frequency。

active_response.title: Block an address that keeps failing to log in to the PMG web interface
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖一再登入 PMG 網頁介面失敗的位址
active_response.body: After rule 132405 (six failed logins from one address in five minutes) or 132496 (failed logins for six different accounts from one address in 10 minutes, password spraying), drops all traffic from that address on the attacked PMG node for 10 minutes, using iptables or nftables. The pack decodes the address without the ::ffff: prefix PMG writes, so the IPv4 rule applies. Restricting pmgproxy with ALLOW_FROM (see the setup step) is the better first measure. Risks: the block covers every port, not only 8006, so a host that also sends mail through the gateway (an internal mail server, users behind a shared NAT address submitting on port 26, a cluster peer) has its mail refused for 10 minutes; an administrator who mistypes a password is locked out; if the web interface sits behind a reverse proxy, the proxy's address is blocked and with it everyone. Put management networks, mail servers and cluster nodes in the manager's white_list first. Do not attach this to SMTP rejections.
active_response.body_zh: 規則 132405（同一位址五分鐘內登入失敗六次）或 132496（同一位址 10 分鐘內對六個不同帳號登入失敗，密碼噴灑）觸發後，在被攻擊的 PMG 節點上以 iptables 或 nftables 封鎖該位址所有流量 10 分鐘。本套件解碼時已去掉 PMG 寫的 ::ffff: 前綴，所以 IPv4 規則會生效。以 ALLOW_FROM 限制 pmgproxy（見部署步驟）是更好的第一步。風險：封鎖涵蓋所有連接埠而不只 8006，因此同時透過閘道寄信的主機（內部郵件伺服器、共用 NAT 位址後經 26 埠送信的使用者、叢集另一節點）會有 10 分鐘信件被拒；一再打錯密碼的管理者會被擋在外面；若網頁介面在反向代理後面，被封的是代理的位址，所有人一起被擋。請先把管理網段、郵件伺服器與叢集節點加入 manager 的 white_list。不要把它套用在 SMTP 拒收上。
